issue_context.title: Error return from Request.ParseForm() shouldn't be ignored
issue_context.body:
**What happened**:
In handler#handleSummary, return value from request.Request.ParseForm() is ignored.

**What you expected to happen**:
The error return should be checked.
comments: Hi @tedyu, this seems to be easy to fix. Could I solve this?

review_comments: Can you talk more about why we are appending the `parse form failed` component? Will that not be apparent from the `err`?

It helps us better understand the context where the error is produced and It allows me to check in the test that effectively the error was produced when parsing the form. This case was about an invalid `Content-Type` but it could be any other so by adding some context you know that specific error was while parsing the form.
Mhhm interesting! Curious if others have strong opinions - my personal vote would probably be that it isn't necessary, but I'm flexible.
